newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle markets quiet - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle markets quiet - USDA.

text.p: Trade inactive in the panhandle area early Tuesday. Slaughter steers and heifers not tested, USDA said.

Feedlots reporting light inquiry from buyers. 22,300 confirmed for the week to date which includes 19,900 head of formulated cattle and 700 head or 19 loads of CME cattle delivered to area packing plants.
Today's packer bids are 68.00-69.00 with asking prices 70.00-71.00. The last established price was 69.00 on Monday.
